content.hebrew: רַחוּם אִם אַתָּה לֹא תְרַחֵם מִי יְרַחֵם.
content.transliteration: Raḥum im atta lo teraḥem mi yeraḥem,
content.english: O merciful one, if you are not merciful who will be merciful?

content.hebrew: רַחֲמֶיךָ רַבִּים יוָי כְּמִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ חַיֵּנִי:
content.transliteration: Raḥamecha rabbim adonai kemishpatecha ḥayyeni.
content.english: You have very much mercy, Adonai; keep me alive, in accordance with your regular practice. (Psalms 119:56)

content.hebrew: מוֹשִׁיעַ אִם אַתָּה לֹא תוֹשִׁיעַ מִי יוֹשִׁיעַ.
content.transliteration: Moshiya‘ im atta lo toshiya‘ mi yoshiya‘,
content.english: O rescuer, if you do not rescue, who will rescue?

content.hebrew: הוֹשִׁיעֵנִי מִפִּי אַרְיֵה וּמִקַּרְנֵי רֵמִים עֲנִיתָנִי:
content.transliteration: Hoshi‘eni mippi aryē umiḳḳarnē remim ‘anitani.
content.english: Rescue me from the lion’s mouth; you have answered me from the horns of wild cattle. (Psalms 22:22)

content.hebrew: זוֹכֵר אִם אַתָּה לֹא תִזְכֹּר מִי יִזְכֹּר.
content.transliteration: Zocher im atta lo tizkor mi yizkor,
content.english: O rememberer, if you do not remember, who will remember?

content.hebrew: זָכְרֵנִי יוָי בִּרְצוֹן עַמֶּךָ פָּקְדֵנִי בִּישׁוּעָתֶךָ:
content.transliteration: Zochreni adonai birtson ‘ammecha poḳdeni bishu‘atecha.
content.english: Remember me, Adonai, when you show favor to your people; take account of me when you rescue. (Psalms 106:4)

content.hebrew: חוֹמֵל אִם אַתָּה לֹא תַחְמֹל מִי יַחְמֹל.
content.transliteration: Ḥomel im atta lo taḥmol mi yaḥmol,
content.english: O compassionate one, if you do not show compassion, who will show compassion?

content.hebrew: וְחָמַלְתִּי עֲלֵיהֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר יַחְמֹל אִישׁ עַל בְּנוֹ הָעֹבֵד אֹתוֹ:
content.transliteration: Veḥamalti ‘alehem ka’asher yaḥmol ish ‘al beno ha‘oved oto.
content.english: And I shall show compassion to them, as a man shows compassion to his son, who serves him. (Malachi 3:17)

content.hebrew: מְכַפֵּר אִם אַתָּה לֹא תְכַפֵּר מִי יְכַפֵּר.
content.transliteration: Mechapper im atta lo techapper mi yechapper,
content.english: O atoner, if you do not atone, who will atone?

content.hebrew: כַּפֵּר לְעַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר פָּדִיתָ יוָי:
content.transliteration: Kapper le‘ammecha yisra’el asher padita adonai.
content.english: Atone for your people Israel, which you have redeemed, O Adonai. (Deuteronomy 21:8)

content.hebrew: עוֹזֵר אִם אַתָּה לֹא תַעְזוֹר מִי יַעְזוֹר.
content.transliteration: ‘Ozer im atta lo ta‘zor mi ya‘zor,
content.english: O helper, if you do not help, who will help?

content.hebrew: עָזְרֵנִי יוָי אֱלֹהַי הוֹשִׁיעֵנִי כְחַסְדֶּךָ:
content.transliteration: ‘Ozreni adonai elohai hoshi‘eni cheḥasdecha.
content.english: Help me, Adonai my God; rescue me, in accordance with your constant kindness. (Psalms 109:26)

content.hebrew: סוֹמֵךְ אִם אַתָּה לֹא תִסְמֹךְ מִי יִסְמֹךְ.
content.transliteration: Somech im atta lo tismoch mi yismoch,
content.english: O you who prop up, if you do not prop up, who will prop up?

content.hebrew: סָמְכֵנִי כְאִמְרָתְךָ וְאֶחְיֶה וְאַל תְּבִישֵׁנִי מִשִּׂבְרִי:
content.transliteration: Somcheni che’imratecha ve’eḥye ve’al tevisheni missivri.
content.english: Support me in accordance with your word, and let me live; and do not frustrate my hope. (Psalms 119:116)

content.hebrew: מְעוֹדֵד אִם אַתָּה לֹא תְעוֹדֵד מִי יְעוֹדֵד.
content.transliteration: Me‘oded im atta lo te‘oded mi ye‘oded,
content.english: O strengthener, if you do not strengthen, who will strengthen?

content.hebrew: מְעוֹדֵד עֲנָוִים יוָי מַשְׁפִּיל רְשָׁעִים עֲדֵי אָרֶץ:
content.transliteration: Me‘oded ‘anavim adonai mashpil resha‘im ‘adē arets.
content.english: Adonai strengthens the meek, and hurls the wicked down to the ground. (Psalms 147:6)

content.hebrew: פּוֹדֶה אִם אַתָּה לֹא תִפְדֶּה מִי יִפְדֶּה.
content.transliteration: Podē im atta lo tifdē mi yifdē,
content.english: O redeemer, if you do not redeem, who will redeem?

content.hebrew: פּוֹדֶה יוָי נֶפֶשׁ עֲבָדָיו וְלֹא יֶאְשְׁמוּ כָּל הַחֹסִים בּוֹ:
content.transliteration: Podē adonai nefesh ‘avadav velo ye’shemu kol haḥosim bo.
content.english: Adonai redeems the life of his servants, and all that put trust in him will not be condemned. (Psalms 34:23)

content.hebrew: רוֹעֶה אִם אַתָּה לֹא תִרְעֶה מִי יִרְעֶה.
content.transliteration: Ro‘ē im atta lo tir‘ē mi yir‘ē,
content.english: O shepherd, if you do not shepherd, who will shepherd,

content.hebrew: רְעֵה עַמְּךָ בְשִׁבְטֶךָ צֹאן נַחֲלָתֶךָ שֹׁכְנִי לְבָדָד יַעַר בְּתוֹךְ כַּרְמֶל יִרְעוּ בָשָׁן וְגִלְעָד כִּימֵי עוֹלָם:
content.transliteration: Re‘ē ‘ammecha veshivtecha tson naḥalatecha shocheni levadad ya‘ar betoch karmel yir‘u vashan veḡil‘ad kimē ‘olam.
content.english: Shepherd your people with your staff, the flock of your inheritance, who dwell solitarily, as a forest in the midst of the fruitful field; let them feed in Bashan and Gilead, as in the days of old.

content.hebrew: שֹׁמֵר אִם אַתָּה לֹא תִשְׁמֹר מִי יִשְׁמֹר.
content.transliteration: Shomer im atta lo tishmor mi yishmor,
content.english: O watcher, if you do not watch, who will watch?

content.hebrew: שָׁמְרֵנִי כְּאִישׁוֹן בַּת עָיִן בְּצֵל כְּנָפֶיךָ תַּסְתִּירֵנִי:
content.transliteration: Shomreni ke’ishon bat ‘ayin betsel kenafecha tastireni.
content.english: Watch me like the apple of your eye; keep me protected in the shade of your wings. (Psalms 17:8)

content.hebrew: עוֹנֶה אִם אַתָּה לֹא תַעֲנֶה מִי יַעֲנֶה.
content.transliteration: ‘Onē im atta lo ta‘anē mi ya‘anē,
content.english: O answerer, if you do not answer, who will answer?

content.hebrew: עֲנֵנִי יוָי כִּי טוֹב חַסְדֶּךָ כְּרֹב רַחֲמֶיךָ פְּנֵה אֵלָי:
content.transliteration: ‘Aneni adonai ki tov ḥasdecha kerov raḥamecha penē elai.
content.english: Answer me, Adonai, for your constant kindness is good; turn to me, in accordance with your great mercy. (Psalms 69:17)

content.hebrew: מֹשֵׁךְ אִם אַתָּה לֹא תִמְשֹׁךְ מִי יִמְשְׁוֹךְ.
content.transliteration: Moshech im atta lo timshoch mi yimshoch,
content.english: O you who draw down, if you do not draw down, who will draw down?

content.hebrew: מְשֹׁךְ חַסְדְּךָ לְיֹדְעֶיךָ וְצִדְקָתְךָ לְיִשְׁרֵי לֵב:
content.transliteration: Meshoch ḥasdecha leyode‘echa vetsidḳatecha leyishrē lev.
content.english: Draw down your constant kindness to those that know you, and your justice to those of upright heart. (Psalms 36:11)

content.hebrew: תּוֹמֵךְ אִם אַתָּה לֹא תִתְמוֹךְ מִי יִתְמוֹךְ.
content.transliteration: Tomech im atta lo titmoch mi yitmoch,
content.english: O supporter, if you do not support, who will support?

content.hebrew: תָּמֹךְ אֲשׁוּרַי בְּמַעְגְּלוֹתֶיךָ בַּל נָמוֹטוּ פְעָמָי:
content.transliteration: Tamoch ashurai bema‘gelotecha bal namotu fe‘amai.
content.english: Support my footsteps on your paths, so my feet will not stumble. (Psalms 17:5)
